retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male figure in a leather jacket with dramatic shadows and realistic facial trauma.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
the subject needs to be smiling

recipe.visualDefinition: A somber, low-key portrait of a man with slicked-back, wet-look hair, wearing a black leather biker jacket. The lighting is highly directional, casting deep shadows that obscure half the face and the background entirely. The subject has visible bruises and blood on his face and white t-shirt, looking downward in a defeated or contemplative pose.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject emerges from a pure black void
Hard light highlights the texture of the leather and hair
Downward gaze creates a mood of introspection or pain
Contrast between the white shirt and black jacket anchors the center
coreInvariants: Visible skin texture and realistic facial trauma

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, head and shoulders filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bridge of the nose and the highlight on the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes are drawn to the bright forehead, down the bridge of the nose to the blood on the shirt, then out to the texture of the leather jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space at the top and sides, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows (Background and Jacket)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale skin tones and white t-shirt
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted crimson and brownish-red (Blood and bruises)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, flesh tones, and dried blood red

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single condensed sans-serif for all informational text.
graphicDevices: Solid white rectangular border/background for the text block

avoid: Transparent backgrounds for the text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and authoritative feel of the advisory label.
Provides a clean, modern, and legible look within a small footprint.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key cinematic portrait of a man with slicked-back hair and a black leather jacket against a pure black background. Use chiaroscuro lighting to highlight facial texture and bruises. Leave the bottom right corner clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small white rectangle in the bottom right corner. Inside the rectangle, typeset three lines of bold, condensed sans-serif text in black, centered and stacked.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?
Is the text contained within a solid white box?

adjustableVariables: Amount of hair straying from the slicked-back style
mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the jacket hardware
Exact wording of the advisory label to avoid trademark issues

mustAchieve: Deep, noise-free blacks in the shadows

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic shadow fall-off on the face
Ensure the white shirt has visible blood staining
Verify the leather jacket has specular highlights
Confirm the text box is perfectly rectangular and opaque
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key lighting + Leather texture + Facial trauma + Downward gaze = Gritty Cinematic Portrait
